metadata.title: DTC Cross-Border Multi-Platform Sourcing & Spy Radar Matrix
metadata.scope: B2C Marketplaces & DTC Independent Stores (Shopify / TikTok Shop DTC)
metadata.description: Cross-verification topology across 8 major data streams to identify scalable e-commerce winning products

monitored_lists.signal_value: Proven market depth and total addressable volume (TAM)
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Benchmark for customer willingness to pay and core reviews critique

monitored_lists.signal_value: Sudden demand spikes (+500% to +5000% rank jump)
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Primary trigger for fast-turnaround 7d-14d independent site testing

monitored_lists.signal_value: New entrants achieving rapid organic traction without years of reviews
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Reveals newly emerging form factors and packaging redesigns

monitored_lists.signal_value: Unfulfilled customer intent and emotional gifting propensity
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Key source for Q4 holiday bundling and AOV booster offers

monitored_lists.signal_value: Maximum impulse conversion algorithms and extreme unit volume
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Identifies items with universal consumer appeal; DTC must avoid identical baseline items and offer differentiated packaging, bundles, or premium aesthetic variants

monitored_lists.signal_value: High satisfaction, low return rate, mass-market problem solver
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Validates factory supply chain stability in Yiwu/Guangdong

monitored_lists.signal_value: Micro-trends in colorways, aesthetics (Y2K, Quiet Luxury, Coquette, Clean Girl)
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Ideal for fast dropshipping and 14d-30d TikTok fashion & jewelry testing

monitored_lists.signal_value: Wholesale dropshipping order counts from European/American merchants
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Gauge early European ad-testing volume before US market saturation

platforms.platform_name: DTC Ad Spy & Shopify Revenue Trackers (PiPiADS, Minea, ShopHunter, AdSpy, Dropship.io)

monitored_lists.list_name: TikTok & Meta Winning Ad Creative Leaderboards
monitored_lists.signal_value: Ad impressions > 1,000,000, Ad run duration > 7 days, Like/Comment velocity > 5%
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Direct proof of profitable ROAS; shows exact landing page design, checkout upsells, and video hooks

monitored_lists.list_name: Shopify Top 1000 Stores Daily Revenue Velocity
monitored_lists.signal_value: Single product stores scaling from $0 to $10,000/day in under 14 days
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Copywriting blueprints, guarantee badges, bundle offers (Buy 2 Get 1 Free, 40% Off)

platforms.platform_name: TikTok Shop & Social Video Commerce (FastMoss, Kalodata, #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt)

monitored_lists.signal_value: Top viral affiliate products driven by micro-influencer UGC videos
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Demonstration virality, 3-second hook potential, ASMR tactile satisfaction

platforms.platform_type: Search Engine Macro Demand & Organic Interest

monitored_lists.signal_value: Unprompted high-intent buying searches triggered by news, seasonal shifts, or cultural moments
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: SEO keyword targeting, Google Shopping Ads, and early product cycle capture

monitored_lists.signal_value: Predictable annual peaks (e.g. November Black Friday, January New Year Fitness, May Mother's Day)
monitored_lists.dtc_relevance: Validates 60-day and 90-day procurement lead times for ocean container shipments
